label: The step-by-step guide to User manuals: every step, spotlight, narration and picture

params.name: lede
params.default: Write a manual once and use it everywhere: one file for a USB stick, a PDF for print and a public page on this portal. Here is how to build, preview, publish and link one.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: steps

default.title: Your manuals
default.say: Every manual of the current project is listed here with its page count, whether it is live or a draft, and who changed it last. Open carries on editing; a live manual shows its public address.

default.title: New manual
default.say: Press New manual to begin with a cover and one blank page. All manuals brings you back to the list whenever you like.

default.title: The cover
default.say: The Cover holds the title, subtitle, author, version, date and time, a background and an optional Cover picture. It is the first page every reader sees.

default.title: Pages
default.say: Each page has a Header, a Background, a Picture with its Picture label, and a Description. Format the text from the toolbar, add a Heading or a Link, and reorder pages with the arrow buttons.

default.title: Documents which screen
default.say: Documents which screen ties a page to a screen of your project. Once the manual is published, that screen's How to Use gains a link to this page, with no extra step.

default.title: Add a page
default.say: Add a page appends a blank page at the end of the manual. Remove takes a page out, and asks first.

default.title: Preview
default.say: The Preview redraws a moment after you type, exactly as your reader will see it. Refresh redraws it on demand, and Print / PDF prints the manual or saves it as a PDF.

default.title: Save and publish
default.say: Save keeps your work as a draft nobody else can read. Publish gives the manual a public link anyone can open without signing in; Unpublish takes it off that link again.

default.title: Download
default.say: Download saves the whole manual as one HTML file that opens from a USB stick without a connection and prints cleanly. Building, publishing and downloading a manual is free.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
